intended_stage: Step 2.1 inventory only; no claim of runtime KB deployment or ruleset execution

source_inventory.merged_function_note: Historical Conditions and Medical History share one clinical owner; code not merged

source_authority.user_expert: Dictated Nexus clinical policy; no new expert approval requested
source_authority.preservation: Previously supplied Drug and AE clinical packages are user-owned local downloads, not asserted as committed in this branch

regulatory_note: References describe supporting data structures, not proof that every Nexus decision convention is mandated. Clinical and jurisdictional conflicts remain explicitly scoped before activation.

rules.requirement: All medicinal products: suspect, concomitant, treatment and historical; preserve verbatim names, chronology and patient linkage.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Historical drugs have ended before relevant suspect exposure; concomitant drugs overlap suspect exposure; source-specific chronology governs uncertainty.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Treatment for an already occurring AE retains treatment role within that ICSR even if subsequent itching or another AE is attributed to it; preserve new reaction attribution separately, consider separate case only under case policy.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Same reported product strength and formulation may contain multiple dosage regimens with independent start, stop, dose, dose unit, frequency and route; repeat exposure and a new event do not automatically create another ICSR.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

citations.scope: repeatable dosage data; Nexus regimen grouping remains a design policy

rules.requirement: Explicitly different strengths or formulations cause distinct drug product records; differences solely in route or dose do not establish a formulation change.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Never infer pharmaceutical form from route (IV does not prove injection formulation); missing strength and form remain unknown; ambiguous product grouping needs review.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Identity and regimen rules apply equally to suspect, concomitant, historical and treatment products.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Where only generic reported, populate Nexus brand and generic fields with generic. Where a verified brand reported, preserve brand and resolve generic ingredient with provenance.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Use versioned WHO Drug and tenant/client product master for identity resolution where available; do company ownership checks ONLY for suspect products.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Generic-only match to MAH master is provisionally company suspect unless verified incompatible product strength, formulation, marketing authorization/market information or other exclusion evidence; avoid definitive identity claims on generic alone.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Multiple discontinuous historical exposures must be separately represented with each partial or full start/stop date; NEVER consolidate earliest start and latest stop into continuous exposure; apply to spontaneous and trial data.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

citations.scope: repeatable relevant past drug history; one exposure per entry is Nexus convention, not explicitly mandated

rules.requirement: Previous non-suspected vaccine doses belong to relevant past drug history when clinically relevant; suspected vaccine product/dose belongs with suspects; preserve dose sequence without inventing it.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

citations.scope: reported prior vaccine dose representation; verify edition in regulatory review

rules.requirement: Extract all explicitly reported clinically adverse events separately under Nexus default, including separately reported rash and itching or fever and body temperature increased; do not silently collapse symptoms under a diagnosis.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Do not infer diagnosis, disease, disorder or AE from laboratory measurements or vital signs alone; anemia cannot be diagnosed from lab data and fever cannot be inferred merely from measured temperature.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Before coding, reject purely nonclinical complaints such as 'your product cost me a lot' as AE; preserve source but return no AE.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Distinguish metaphor/slang/subjective statements including 'I felt like I died' from documented death; do not code fatal outcome without source evidence; route ambiguity for review.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Preserve paired source verbatim term, agent-selected AE, evidence location, optional terminology suggestion and rationale per extracted event.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Event outcome is source-grounded: improved means recovering/resolving, disappeared means recovered/resolved, without information unknown; preserve source verbatim.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Record event onset and cessation at source precision; when recovered date is supported, it may equal event stop date; no invented unsupported dates.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Relative exact day counts ('15 days back', 'yesterday') may be anchored to a reliable report date; vague phrases ('last month') require partial date precision, not fabricated day.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Severity (intensity) and regulatory seriousness are separate, independently evidenced assessments; severe does not imply serious.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Nexus default is every separately reported clinical AE; client-specific coding differences may be configured only through an authorized, compliant scoped policy.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Clinical NLP interprets regional expressions, slang, negation and temporality, but cannot manufacture clinical findings from ambiguous phrases.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: IRD/Day Zero/clock start: for direct MAH cases, first receipt by ANY MAH employee/department of information meeting all four minimum ICSR validity criteria; internal PV transfer delays do not move date.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: MR's first oral awareness from physician and scientist's conference awareness can be MAH awareness; retain original evidence date over later email.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: If first MAH receipt does not meet all minimum validity criteria, document initial information and set valid-case IRD when final criterion is first received.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: For database-searched literature reports, use MAH PV retrieval/stamp date under user's Nexus convention, not article publication date; preserve published and retrieved timestamps separately.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: For third-party social-media monitoring use report retrieval/first discovery date; for MAH-owned channel direct reports use original qualifying posting date.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: For partner/vendor-labelled cases, use partner's original valid ICSR receipt date instead of later MAH desk receipt as user's proposed rule; preserve partner source date and transfer date.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Capture action taken with suspect product per drug, including explicit No Change, Drug Withdrawn, Dose Reduced, Dose Increased, Temporary Interruption, Unknown and Not Applicable.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Positive dechallenge under user's convention: AE improves/resolves after suspect withdrawal or dose reduction without AE-specific treatment; preserve pair-level chronology.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: If AE-specific treatment was given and event recovered/improved, user's rule classifies dechallenge Not Applicable; preserve treatment evidence and do not extrapolate cross-event treatment.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: When qualifying action or event course is insufficient, dechallenge Unknown rather than Not Assessable; a supported no-improvement course after withdrawal/reduction may be Negative.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Under user's convention, if dechallenge is Unknown or Not Applicable, rechallenge defaults Not Applicable; preserve all independently reported re-administration and recurrence evidence rather than discarding it.
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

rules.requirement: Historical Conditions and Medical History are one clinical function, not competing agents; include prior clinical conditions and social history (alcohol, tobacco, recreational substances and reported suicidal history).
rules.source: Clinical expert dictation in Nexus discussion 2026-10-09

open_topics: Clinical rule coverage for patient/reporter/current-condition/COI/duplicate/literature/follow-up agents has not been fully dictated; retain existing logic and do not invent user approval.
Drug indication mapping has proposed rules but was not signed off in the session.
Do not interpret No Change as not applicable in Action Taken.
Nexus treatment-confounded dechallenge/rechallenge convention requires regulatory applicability review before live clinical activation.
Partial event dates must not use IRD as anchor if source indicates a different reference date.
Company-suspect market applicability needs time-specific MAH authorization information.

expert_approval.meaning: Requirements approved for implementation; not an assertion that placeholder execution is validated or clinically production-qualified
